carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the mid-lateral line of the posterior trunk, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and deep shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora is attached to the trailing ventral edge of the lower caudal lobe; a secondary high-intensity white organism is present near the ventral junction of the caudal peduncle and the tail fin.
